_comment: Machine-readable mirror of TASKS.md for Scripts/agent-loop/*. TASKS.md stays the human-readable source of truth; this file is regenerated/edited alongside it by the loop. Do not let an agent edit this file for a ticket it is not currently claiming.
_reserved_files_comment: Files no automated ticket may ever touch; any diff touching these forces human_gate regardless of the ticket's own flag. TASKS.md and tickets.json are handled separately below since every ticket legitimately edits its OWN status line in both -- gate.py checks that edit is scoped to just that ticket's entry, not a reserved file in the blanket sense.
